baselineDisplay.title: How do you do
baselineDisplay.question: What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 迈克尔·贝克和杰里米·肖特是做什么工作的？
baselineDisplay.text:
What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?

Come and meet our employees Mr. Richards.
Thank you Mr. Jackson.
This is Nicola Grey and this is Claire Taylor.
How do you do?
Those women are very hard-working.
What are their jobs?
They're keyboard operators.
This is Michael Baker and this is Jeremy Short.
How do you do?
They aren't very busy!
What are their jobs?
They're sales reps.
They're very lazy.
Who is this young man?
This is Jim.
He's our office assistant.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
理查兹先生，来认识一下我们的员工吧。
谢谢杰克逊先生。
这位是尼古拉·格雷，这位是克莱尔·泰勒。
你好！
那些女士工作很勤奋。
她们是做什么工作的？
她们是键盘操作员。
这位是迈克尔·贝克，这位是杰里米·肖特。
你好！
他们不怎么忙！
他们是做什么工作的？
他们是销售代表。
他们很懒。
这个年轻人是谁？
这位是吉姆。
他是我们的办公室助理。
